name: First Ken
description: Turn the waking soul outward a hand's breadth and feel the warmth of every living body within arm's reach.

name: Skin Feel
description: Run the soul along the skin of the user's own body to learn where soul ends and flesh begins.

name: Closed Hand
description: Draw the soul in and hold it shut like a fist so that a clumsy soul touch slides off.

name: Heed Mark
description: Pick out one nearby person and keep a steady feel of that person's soul until they leave reach.

name: Thin Prick
description: Send a hair-thin point of soul force at one target's mind to cause a sudden flinch.

name: Level Breath
description: Steady the user's breath and soul together so that the next sensing move holds longer.

name: Outward Ken
description: Push the soul out in a slow ring until it feels every living body within a few paces.

name: Warmth Count
description: Take a quick count of the living bodies near the user and note which stand still and which move.

name: Facing Read
description: Feel which way a nearby person's attention is turned and keep that direction in mind.

name: Hush Touch
description: Lay a soft hush over one foe's soul so that the foe's next attempt to feel the user comes back blurred.

name: Ring Guard
description: Hold the soul in a tight ring around the user to turn aside a weak soul touch.

name: Clear Ken
description: Sweep stray feeling out of the user's own soul so that the next sensing move reaches farther.

name: Still Ear
description: Hold the soul perfectly still and let the feeling of nearby people arrive without reaching for it.

name: Mood Catch
description: Catch the plain mood of one person at a glance as calm or tense or glad.

name: Footfall Hark
description: Feel the soul-weight of walkers in the near dark and tell how many approach and how quickly.

name: Pulse Tally
description: Count the heartbeats of one person in reach through the beat that echoes in their soul.

name: Cloth Guard
description: Spread a thin cover of soul force over the mind to dull a rough soul touch.

name: Dull Ear
description: Blunt one foe's own sensing for a few breaths so that foe misjudges where the user stands.

name: Lend Ear
description: Lend a share of the user's soul sharpness to one ally so that the ally notices more for a short while.

name: Locked Gaze
description: Fasten the soul on one person and follow that person's movements without turning the head.

name: Long Gaze
description: Keep the soul turned on one place or one person for hours with little strain.

name: Gaze Rest
description: Let the sensing soul rest while keeping a light hold so that the next long watch does not tire the user.

name: Face Count
description: Count how many separate souls stand in view and mark which one is nearest.

name: Cold Regard
description: Press an unblinking soul gaze on one foe until that foe's nerve begins to slip.

name: Slant Aside
description: Tilt the soul at the last moment so that a soul probe slips past the user's mind.

name: Cast Strand
description: Throw a thin thread of soul at one target so that the target's place can be felt from afar.

name: Thread Hold
description: Keep the cast thread taut so that it follows its target through a crowd.

name: Lantern Rise
description: Raise a soft light of soul that shows every living presence in the room to the user alone.

name: Lantern Dim
description: Lower the user's own glow of soul so that the user is harder to find by the same art.

name: Room Sweep
description: Sweep the soul once around a closed room and learn who and what lies hidden in it.

name: Thread Snap
description: Cut a foe's own sensing thread at its root so that the foe loses track of the user.

name: Spark Guard
description: Cast a small bright spark of soul before the mind to burn off a weak intruding touch.

name: Fine Needle
description: Drive a needle of soul through a foe's guard of mind to sting the thought behind it.

name: Near Feel
description: Feel everything that stands within a few paces as a plain map of living warmth.

name: Arm Reach
description: Reach out one arm's length and learn at once whether the thing in front of the user is alive.

name: Step Warning
description: Feel the sharp shift in a soul that comes just before it strikes and warn the user a breath early.

name: Rough Ward
description: Set a rough coat of soul force over the mind to turn away blunt soul touches.

name: Brush Off
description: Sweep a probing soul touch away from the user with a quick turn of the sensing soul.

name: Tight Fist
description: Pull the sensing soul into a tight fist so that near feeling grows sharper at the cost of range.

name: Fear Weight
description: Feel the heavy cold weight that fear lays on a soul and learn who in reach is afraid.

name: Calm Weight
description: Feel the even slow weight of a calm soul and learn who in reach is at ease.

name: Anger Heat
description: Feel the rising heat of anger in a soul before it shows in the face.

name: Lie Snag
description: Notice the small snag in a soul when the words spoken do not match what it holds.

name: Settle Heart
description: Lay a calm hand of soul on one ally so that the ally's racing heart slows and the mind clears.

name: Dread Nudge
description: Press a small cold fear into one foe's soul so that the foe hesitates.

name: Mind Latch
description: Latch the mind shut against a stranger's reading so that only blank calm shows.

name: Ember Self
description: Draw the user's soul down to a faint ember so that it is hard for other sensing souls to find.

name: Quiet Reach
description: Reach out so lightly that those touched feel nothing at all.

name: Shy Sweep
description: Sweep a room with the faintest brush of soul and withdraw before anyone can mark it.

name: Tracing Back
description: Pull the sensing soul back along its own track and learn what it brushed on the way.

name: Muffle Ward
description: Wrap the soul in a muffling cover so that outside sensing returns only an empty hush.

name: Slip Notice
description: Make a probing foe lose the thread of the user so that the foe's next probe finds only empty air.
